species: Nipponbare (Oryza sativa, ssp. japonica) upon ABA treatment.
tissue: the ABA treatment was conducted by immersing young seedlings in water containing 100 µM ABA.
disease_state: healthy, intact young seedlings were kept in a beaker with water containing 100 µM ABA
sample_source: Fourteen-day-old Nipponbare young seedlings were obtained from pure water culture in a growth chambers
age: a MS-based, quantitative, label-free phosphoproteomic approach was employed to identify the phosphopeptides and phosphosites from 14-day-old young seedlings of Nipponbare
strain: a MS-based, quantitative, label-free phosphoproteomic approach was employed to identify the phosphopeptides and phosphosites from 14-day-old young seedlings of Nipponbare (Oryza sativa, ssp. japonica) upon ABA treatment.
